Results.ReviewText: Very nice quality built grill. It cooks great and is worth cost over those inferior brands out there. I am very satisfied and would recommend this to anyone wanting a great smaller size grill.

Results.ReviewText: My father in law swore by his weber grills, I thought he was full of it.  Turns out, he was right, they are absolutely better than an grill I've ever owned.  That's alot of other grills.

This is my second Weber grill. My first was A
Charcoal grill, which I got a lot of use. Now I have bought the spirit 210 gas grill which I am very, very satisfied with. It is well built well designed and should last me many many years and I am one that will grill a lot several times a week.

Results.ReviewText: This is our third one over about a 15 year time span. We love this it works for the hubby and I, the kids are grown and if they all come with grand kids it still works. Easy to replace burners the igniter button. If you keep them covered and take care of it, it will last a long time.
Results.Title: Weber E-210

Results.ReviewText: It is a great little grill. Very even cooking throughout the cabinet. You can not beat the warranty! The integrity of the metal is amazing. I've had this grill for 8 years and still running strong.
Results.Title: Longevity

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill this is an awesome grill -we love it and plan to use it all winter !
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is the first Weber grill I have owned. I put it together myself. It took me about 2 hours. Good instructions, easy to understand. Following the suggestions included for cooking various meats, I have had perfectly cooked meals. The grill is more sturdy than the others I have owned and seems like it will last a long time.
Results.Title: My First Weber

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill in early July. Had it for three months. Two of the four casters fell off due to rusted and poorly welded mounting brackets. I had to replace the entire bottom section of the grill myself. Not an easy task since some bolts were not easily accessible. Webers used to be the gold standard for grills. Not anymore… very cheaply made now but very expensive.
Results.Title: Casters fell off!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this as a gift for my daughter. I purchased the same grill myself two years ago and love it. Good temperature control and easy cooking and cleanup. Her old grill was a pain to use and clean. So far she is just as happy with her’s as I am with mine.
Results.Title: Perfect size grill

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill- my third Weber in a row. It is a perfect size for my compact space with the fold down shelves. Very easy to control the temperature-better than my last grill. My only quibble is that when we had a very big rain event, rain got in the back and into the grease trap pan- it made a spill inside the cabinet and on the ground. I am very happy overall. Cooking is a breeze -cooked a whole bunch of chicken at once and everyone raved. Salmon this week was awesome.
Results.Title: Perfect Size, Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great combination of high-quality, just the right size and features, in reasonable price. We had a previous Weber that lasted about 10 years so looking forward to another 10 years.
Results.Title: Just the right combination…

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, cooks evenly. Love the ignition start much better than any other brand I purchased in the past.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill, good size and easy to clean. I found the wheels are too small and not well designed. The spring loaded tank holder is a poor design and difficult to use. I added my own inline gauge.
Results.Title: Nice grill but some drawbacks.

Results.ReviewText: We just love our Weber grill I purchased the griddle so I have the best of both worlds I have a grill on one side and a gravel on the other.  So easy to start and easy to clean also purchase the cover to protect our beautiful grill from the weather!  The two burner grill is just perfect for the two of us!
Results.Title: Happy Days!

Results.ReviewText: Owned the same Weber Genesis grill for 23 years, so given the outstanding service I received from this product there was question that I would purchase another Weber grill. Wanted to downsize a bit so I chose the Spirit E-210 grill. Love the smaller compact size of the grill and the really nice grill cabinet that conceals the propane tank.  It has a spacious grilling surface with a nice warming rack.
Results.Title: Weber Grills Are The Best

Results.ReviewText: nice size easy assembly and loving it -perfect size for our family and well made
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.Title: A great choice in grills!

Great grill, works well and I like the starting system!
My Genesis grill was replaced only because the wind blew it off my deck after 24 years!
Results.Title: My first new grill in 24 years!

Results.ReviewText: Grilll exceeds expectations   Has plenty of guts and starts flawlessly
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Another fabulous Weber product. Fit and finish are perfect.
Results.Title: Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: very nice grill, solid build compared to other brands I've owned, cooks nicely, achievers very high oven temperature very quick with lid closed, glad I finally moved up to a Weber after owning many other brands, hopefully it will last many years
Results.Title: 2 burner

Results.ReviewText:
Love the grill.  Assembly instructions were easy to follow.  Hardware kit was short one washer and one screw in hardware pack 'C'.  Contacted Weber and they shipped a complete hardware 'C' pack overnight at no cost.  Very pleased with their Customer Service.

The only negative I would add to my experience is the bottom compartment, rear panel has been recently redesigned and  shortened so it doesn't completely hide the LP tank from a rear view of the grill.  The model shown at Lowe's was apparently the previous version had had the larger back panel.  The Customer Service Rep could only say that the larger panel had been discontinued and was no longer available.  No explanation for this change was offered; but I suspect making a larger opening for the tank compartment was for safety.  If the tank leaked, the gas would be able to vent out much easier.  It doesn't look as nice but if the change was for safety, I fully support it.
Results.Title: Owner

Results.ReviewText: Faulty valve, hard to navigate weber site for customer service. I still can't find my case in my profile.
Results.Title: Faulty valve

Results.ReviewText:
I recently purchased a Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane), and I couldn't be happier with it. I snagged it on discount, which made the deal even better. While I had to assemble it myself, the process was straightforward—thanks to clear instructions and helpful pictographs. 

The grill feels sturdy and well-designed, perfectly meeting the needs of my small family. In just a month, I've used it twelve times, and it’s been fantastic for grilling vegetables, steaks, burgers, and brats. 

My only minor concern is that a couple of small screws have fallen out, despite tightening them by hand and using a drill for extra security. Overall, based on my experience so far and my previous Weber grill, which lasted over seven years, I would definitely recommend the Spirit E-210.
Results.Title: Happy with my purchase

Results.ReviewText: I have owned several Weber grills over the years and I have to say, this is my favorite.  It is perfect for my wife and I!  It heats up fast and cooks great.
Results.Title: My Favorite Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I would give no stars, if possible, worst purchase and service I have ever had. I never received my grill, so I canceled the order and as of this date I am still attempting to get my refund after three weeks. When I called customer service, they keep telling me that my refund will be processed in 3 to 5 business days, but it still has not. I am currently at the point that I may seek legal action if my money is not returned.
Results.Title: Do Not Attempt to buy online!!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill - I replaced my 10 year old E-210 with this one.  I like these cooking grates better than the older one.  I noticed the lid is not as heavy duty - not really a big deal.  My biggest complaint is the back panel of the grill only coves about 1/3 of the area   - seems to be a petty way to save production costs.  Fortunately I use a grill cover so it’s not the end of the world.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Well built, sturdy, cooks evenly, everything you want in a personal grill. I’m sure to enjoy it for years.  Good investment!
Results.Title: Only way to grill-Weber!!

Results.ReviewText: Always heard that Weber grills were the best. I agree. The quality of the grill is outstanding.
Results.Title: Best grill I've ever bought

Results.ReviewText:
Great grill. Had 3 other non-Weber grills in the past couple of years that would only last a couple years each. Decided to upgrade and go with a Weber. The quality of this Weber is night and day compared to my old non-Weber grills I owned. I wish I would have bought this grill from the start
 Great quality, easy cleaning, and cooks great. I love this grill.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
